description: Baseline (kb_rrf) metrics on the 10-query hand-curated set from spikes/typed-extraction/eval.py. Harness ran 2026-05-03 with 266 proposals ingested into spike.db.
note: kb_rrf mode calls `aimee kb search --fusion-mode rrf`. Returned empty on 2026-05-03 because Qdrant was in D-state (memory pressure) and no `proposals` KB project exists yet. When a proposals project is indexed, rerun: python3 spikes/typed-extraction/eval.py --mode kb_rrf --queries small
